description: Advisory hooks allowed to exit early (exit 0, no output, no state write) when the active unit's riskTier is exactly low. Gates, enforcement hooks, evidence producers and the session-start context hooks (pre-flight-check, session-open-diagnostic) are never listed (tests/verify_hook_tier_exit.py). G-003, ADR-011.

hooks.reason: long-session hint only; no deny, no evidence read by any gate
soft reminder about unbounded output; never blocks
repeat-pattern hint only; its window state is read by nothing else
Stop-time /session-save reminder; systemMessage only, never a deny
